children: Consensus Cloud Solutions entered into an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement providing a $225 million senior secured revolving credit facility and a $300 million senior secured delayed-draw term loan, maturing Sept. 30, 2031. The revolver is reborrowable; the DDTL is drawable until Oct. 15, 2028, to fund the planned retirement of $348.2 million of 6.50% notes due 2028 around Oct. 15, 2027. Loans bear interest at a base rate or SOFR plus a margin tied to total net leverage, and the facility includes leverage and fixed charge covenants. Existing obligations under the prior 2025 agreement rolled into the new facility.
: Senior secured $225M revolving credit facility and $300M delayed-draw term loan
: U.S. Bank, as agent, and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity and fund retirement of 2028 senior notes
